programs.title: When Mom Becomes a Murderer
programs.desc: Following the murder of her best friend, an introverted teen discovers her mom has a secret past that involves a similar crime. Desperate to uncover the truth, she soon finds herself in over her head as she wonders if her mother is a killer.

programs.title: Stepmom From Hell
programs.desc: Izzy suspects foul play in her dad's business as he declines rapidly, but nothing could prepare her for the deceit and danger she will uncover.

programs.title: Nightmare School Moms

programs.title: Nightmare PTA Moms
programs.desc: Hoping to get more involved at her daughter's new middle school, a woman joins the PTA, only to encounter a power-hungry mother who has a penchant for backstabbing.

programs.title: The Hockey Mom's Revenge
programs.desc: Diane is a former hockey player who becomes obsessed with the success of her son, Alex. Fueled by jealousy toward Rachel and her star son, she manipulates, sabotages and endangers others to ensure Alex comes out on top.

programs.title: The Ice Rink Murders
programs.desc: After time away from the ice, elite figure skater Megan returns to training, only to find that a killer targeting skaters is giving a whole new meaning to the phrase cutthroat competition.
